title: Group of People Vintage Snapshot, 1930s Sepia Photo, USA
description: A vintage 1930s snapshot capturing a casual group portrait of three people, featuring a smiling woman crouching in the foreground and a man standing behind. The photo displays noticeable fading, discoloration, and double exposure ghosting, typical of early amateur candid photography. The reverse side bears a simple blue ink stamp reading 'B 3'.
